questions.q_en: If a problem involves division, the divisor is twelve times the quotient and ten times the remainder. If the remainder is 18, then the dividend is:

Quotient = 15

Dividend = 180 * 15 + 18 = 2718

questions.q_en: A boat can travel 5 km upstream in 15 minutes. If the ratio of speed of the boat in still water to the speed of the stream is 6:1, how much time will the boat take to cover 19.6 km downstream?
questions.solution_en:
Let the speed of the boat be 6x and that of the stream be x.

Then, upstream speed = 6x - x = 5x

And, downstream = 6x + x = 7x

Now, upstream speed = (5/15)*60 = 20 kmph

So, 5x = 20

x = 4 kmph

Thus, speed of the stream = 4 kmph

Therefore, downstream speed = 7x = 28 kmph

Therefore, time taken downstream to cover 19.6 km = 19.6*60/28 = 42 minutes

questions.q_en: A certain loan was returned in two equal half-yearly instalments each of Rs. 2704. If the rate of interest was 8 % p.a. compounded yearly, how much was the interest paid on the loan?
questions.solution_en:
[In half yearly, time doubles and interest half]

8%/2 = 4%

Let the principal be Rs. P.

[P * (100 + 4/100) - 2704] * (1 + 4/100) = 2704

[P * 104/100 - 2704] = 2600

P * 104/100 = 5304

P = Rs. 5100

Hence, the interest paid = 2704 * 2 - 5100 = Rs. 308

questions.q_en: The average age of the men in a group is 36 years, and the average age of the women is 30 years. If the combined average age of all people in the group is 34 years, what is the ratio of the number of men to the number of women?

Let m = number of men, w = number of women

According to question,

(36m + 30w) / (m + w) = 34

36m + 30w = 34m + 34w

2m = 4w

m : w = 2 : 1

questions.q_en: Rajkumar decides to sell his watch at a discount of 5%. However, his brother purchases it from him and receives an 8% discount. Rajkumar loses Rs.45 in profit as a result of this. What was the watch's marked price?
questions.solution_en:
Let the marked price of watch = 100x

Price at which Rajkumar intended to sell the Watch = 95% of 100x = 95x

Price at which his brother purchases the watch = 92% of 100x = 92x

According to the question:

95x - 92x = 45

x = 15

Marked price = 100x = ₹1500

questions.q_en: The inner circumference of a circular track is 121/7 cm. Find the diameter of the outer circle of the track if the track is 10 cm wide.
questions.solution_en:
Inner circumference = 121/7

2πr = 121/7

2 x (22/7) x r = 121/7

r = 11/4 = 2.75 cm

Outer radius of track = 2.75 + 10 = 12.75 cm

Diameter of outer circle of track = 12.75 x 2 = 25.5 cm

questions.q_en: If a solid cone of volume 27π cm3 is kept inside a hollow cylinder whose radius and height are of that cone, then the volume of water needed to fill the empty space is:
questions.solution_en:
Volume of water needed to fill the empty space = volume of cylinder - volume of cone

= π X r2 X h - 1/3 X π X r2 X h

= 2/3 X π X r2 X h

= 2 X (1/3 X π X r2 X h)

= 2 X 27π cm3

= 54π cm3

Express Method

When a solid cone is kept inside a hollow cylinder whose radius and height are equal to the cylinder, the ratio of the volumes of the cylinder to that of the cone = 3: 1

Given Volume of cone = 27π

So, Volume of cylinder = 3 * 27π

Volume of water needed to fill the empty space = Volume of cylinder - volume of cone

= 81π - 27π

= 54π cm3

questions.q_en: Nishu walks around a circular field at the speed of 3 rounds per hour, while Aman runs around it at the speed of 11 rounds per hour. They start in the same direction from the same point at 7: 15 p.m. Find the time at which they cross each other.
questions.solution_en:
Relative speed = 11 - 3 = 8 rounds per hour

Time = Distance of 1 round/relative speed = 1/8 hours = 60/8 = 7.5 minutes

They start at 7: 15 P.M, so they will cross each other at: 7: 15 + 7.5 minutes = 7: 22: 30 seconds (PM)

questions.q_en: 'P' speaks the truth 5 out of 12 times and 'Q' speaks the truth 8 out of 21 times. What is the probability that they contradict each other in stating the same fact?
questions.solution_en:
Probability of P tell a lie = 1 - 5/12 = 7/12

Probability of Q tell a lie = 1 - 8/21 = 13/21

Hence, the required probability = 5/12 * 13/21 + 7/12 * 8/21

= 65/252 + 56/252

= 121/252

questions.q_en: Two drone pilots, stationed at points C and D, are observing the top of a tall radio tower. Pilot C is just 6 meters away from the base of the tower, while Pilot D is much farther back at 96 meters from the base of the tower - both on the same straight runway. Pilot C tilts their drone camera upward at an angle of 54° to capture the top of the tower, while Pilot D does the same but at an angle of 36°. Find the height of the tower.
questions.solution_en:
Let height of tower = H m

In Δ ABC,

Tan54° = H/6

H = 6 * tan54°... (1)

In Δ ABD,

Tan36° = H/96

H = 96 * tan36°... (2)

From equation (1) and (2),

H2 = 96 * 6 * tan54 * tan36

H2 = 576 * tan54 * cot54

H = √576

H = 24 m

Average age of 6 persons is 39 years. Average age of first two persons is 47 years. Age of third person is 16 years more than the age of fourth person. Age of last two persons is same and is 22 years less than the average age of third and fourth person. What is the average age of fourth and fifth person?
questions.solution_en:
Let age of third person = m years

Age of fourth person = m - 16 years

Age of fifth and sixth person = (m + m - 16)/2 - 22 = m - 30 years

Average age of 6 persons = 39 years

2*47 + m + m - 16 + 2(m - 30) = 6*39

94 + 2m - 16 + 2m - 60 = 234

4m = 216

m = 54

Average age of fourth and fifth person = [(54 - 16) + (54 - 30)]/2 = 31 years

Hence rate of interest = 12/2

= 6% = 6/100 = 3/50

No. of periods = 2

Now,

Principal: Amount

50 * 50: 53 * 53

2500: 2809

Given,

2500 units = Rs.25000

2809 units = 25000 x 2809/2500

= Rs.28090
